rci1_using_msad.detail: Dataset 1 (Cam-CAN) was acquired at a single site for the normative model training cohort.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "In dataset 1, all resting-state functional images of participants were obtained at a single site (Medical Research Council [UK] Cognition and Brain Sciences Unit)"

rci2_using_epd.detail: Cam-CAN was used as the healthy reference cohort for normative model training.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Dataset 1, which included 644 healthy individuals, was used in this work to build a normative model and was obtained from the Cambridge Centre for Aging and Neuroscience repository (Cam-CAN, available at http://www.mrc-cbu.cam.ac.uk/datasets/camcan/)"

rci3_epd_name.detail: Cambridge Centre for Aging and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN) dataset used as Dataset 1 for normative model training.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Dataset 1, which included 644 healthy individuals, was used in this work to build a normative model and was obtained from the Cambridge Centre for Aging and Neuroscience repository (Cam-CAN, available at http://www.mrc-cbu.cam.ac.uk/datasets/camcan/)"
